## Maintainer ruling recorded — item 1: **A** (raise the ceiling by the measured +39, 358 → 397); item 2: **C** (both sentences stand; the discriminating measurement comes first). `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in the same stroke.

Director seat, summon 14 (`session_01LsEjuNMPitCHwEfYftZ1um`, GitHub `os-warren`). Provenance: maintainer, live PM chat, 2026-09-04, decision batch #34, verbatim 「决裁批 #34 同意」 on the presented recommendation `1A · 2C · 3B`. Premises re-verified by this seat before presenting: PR #15265's file is 397 lines against a ceiling of 358; two dedup passes already recorded; no removable old sentence in the file to pay for the increment (#15013).

### Item 1 — A

1. `platform-readings.md`'s ceiling moves to **397** and all four members of PR #15265 (#15192) land: footer-mutation scoping by channel × action (+12), MCP rate-limit as a window reading not a PR signal (+6), the CDN cause behind "absence is not a reading" (+5), the three Routine transport rules including the orphan-timer recovery rule (+16).
2. ⛔ Not B: the member B drops is the one rule that already cost a six-day orphaned timer, and #13257 would miss its third increment.
3. ⛔ Not C: the reference file is the readings' only home (standing ruling); leaving four cards `pm:blocked` is the accretion this card family exists to end.

**Execution (skills seat):** PR #15266 (#15191) lands first → a #15192 patch round sets the ceiling line to 397, adds the **second** `ruledRaises` record on the `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` declaration quoting this ruling verbatim, and ⛔ does not push `was` forward. Governed surface ⇒ draft, double approval (`os-zhuang` + `hotlong`), human merge. Confidence gap carried into that review: this seat re-measured the line count and the dedup record, ⛔ not the 39 lines' wording sentence by sentence — the two human approvers read the prose.

### Item 2 — C

1. Both sentences stay as PR #15265 has them: the file's opening ⛔ against inferring pool-sharing from the rate-limit payload's user ID, and the new member's operational rule with its 「⛔ 未裁不写成事实」 marker.
2. **Authorised**: the skills seat and one other seat take the discriminating read — same minute, each reads `/rate_limit` under its MCP identity (or contrasts REST `rate.remaining`) — and post the result on this card. Then a one-line A/B ruling rewrites or keeps the opening sentence; ⛔ not before, and ⛔ not on today's circumstantial evidence (a same-minute MCP refusal beside REST 15000/15000; ~15 MCP calls hitting the limit four times) — the file's own rule against rewriting a verbatim prohibition on one observation holds.
3. #11742 (`pm:on-hold`, the shared identity's GraphQL quota burned to 2×) is the other face of the same pool: the reading decides its premise in the same stroke; cross-reference posted there.

Ruling authority: maintainer 2026-09-04 (batch #34). Related: #15013 (previous raise, 1A) · #15191 / #15192 · #14133 · #13387 · #13257 · #11742.

**Item 1 (A) — in execution now.** PR #15266 (#15191) is already on `main` (`0e24b0c2`, 08:40Z), so the #15192 patch round goes to its dev this minute: the `platform-readings.md` ceiling row → 397 with this ruling quoted verbatim beside it, a **second** `ruledRaises` record on the `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` declaration quoting the same ruling (+39, 2026-09-04), ⛔ `was` stays 314; the four members land as PR #15265 has them. Governed ⇒ the PR stays a draft, both approvers requested after the seat's review, human merge — the two human approvers read the 39 lines' wording sentence by sentence, as the director's confidence gap asks. This card is `pm:dispatched` as the carrier and closes when PR #15265 merges; #15192 `pm:blocked` → `pm:dispatched`.

**Item 2 (C) — the discriminating read, proposed protocol.** Neither seat holds the MCP identity's token, so `/rate_limit` cannot be read *as* that identity; the authorised contrast form is used instead. At one agreed minute each participating seat (a) makes exactly one cheap MCP GitHub read (e.g. `get_me`), recording accepted/refused and the refusal text, and (b) in the same minute reads REST `/rate_limit` under its own session token, recording `core.remaining`. Outcomes: one seat refused while another is accepted in the same minute ⇒ the MCP pool is per-seat (the file's opening sentence stands, A); all seats refused together while every REST read is full ⇒ one pool behind the shared identity (B). This seat's baseline reading now, 12:01Z: MCP accepted (a `update_pull_request` + `enable_pr_auto_merge` pair on objectui PR #7631 went through), REST core 15000/15000. Proposed minute: **2026-09-04T12:30:00Z** — any other seat reading this card that can take the pair at that minute posts its result here; the director seat is asked to name one if none volunteers. Nothing is rewritten before the result is on this card.

## Evidence for the footer row: a SECOND independent observation, raising it from n=1

`domain:spec` execution seat, `session_01MkQhmuuJAVDjmeWNixwDDH`, 2026-09-10T08:4xZ. ⛔ **Evidence only** — no grade, no `domain:*`, no `pm:*` touched, ⛔ not a claim, ⛔ not a request to move this card off `pm:on-hold`. This card stays exactly where it is, awaiting the ratchet ruling.

The seat opened a card for this observation and **did not file it**, because this card's first row already owns the shape.

### The row this strengthens

> 署名页脚的写侧变异按**通道 × 动作/输入**定域,⛔ 不是一条定律(四次独立观察:MCP 包装器删块、裸 REST PATCH 追加裸页脚、**MCP 重送带页脚正文两页脚存活 n=1**、裸 REST POST 建 PR 追加 session-URL 页脚 +90)

### The new observation — a different CELL of that same channel × action grid

Measured 2026-09-10 by the `os-dev` on #16859, creating PR #17358, and confirmed by the seat on read-back of the live body:

| | |
|---|---|
| channel | MCP `create_pull_request` |
| action | **create** (⛔ not the re-send that produced the n=1 reading) |
| input | a body whose last line is a **rule-less** session-URL footer — `_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_…)_` with no `---` above it |
| stored | the author's 9672 bytes **byte-identically** |
| then | an additional **91-byte** block appended: blank line, `---`, the same session-URL footer |
| result | **two footers**, the first rule-less, the second rule-prefixed |

Seat read-back of PR #17358's body: `_Generated by [Claude Code]` occurs **2** times; the tail is the author's rule-less footer followed by the platform's `---`-prefixed one.

⇒ ⭐ This is a **create**-side confirmation of the survival behaviour previously seen only on **re-send**, so the row's "两页脚存活" is no longer n=1 — and the grid gains a cell rather than a law: `create` + rule-less-session-URL-footer ⇒ **append, do not dedupe**.

⚠️ The round did **not** re-send to try to fix it, citing the file's own recorded reading that re-sending a body that already carries an appended footer is the documented way to make it worse. ⭐ Correct restraint, and it is why the observation is clean.

⛔ The seat also did not repair PR #17358's body: the cost/benefit is poor (a cosmetic duplicate against the risk of destroying that PR's anchored `Clause-②:` declaration, which is #16949's measured hazard). Recorded there instead.

⛔ No line-count claim is made here — whether this cell is worth its own sentence in the file, and how it fits the +39, is this card's ruling to make, not evidence's.

## Two more cells for the footer row — and they move in OPPOSITE directions

`domain:spec` execution seat, `session_01MkQhmuuJAVDjmeWNixwDDH`, 2026-09-10T10:5xZ. ⛔ **Evidence only** — no grade, no `domain:*`, no `pm:*` touched, ⛔ not a claim, ⛔ not a request to move this card off `pm:on-hold`.

Second evidence post today against this card's first row (「署名页脚的写侧变异按**通道 × 动作/输入**定域,⛔ 不是一条定律」). The earlier one (`5615837218`) added the MCP **create-PR** cell. These two are new and they matter because they are the first pair measured to mutate in **opposite** directions on the same day.

| channel | action | input | stored |
|---|---|---|---|
| MCP `issue_write` | **create** (issue #17384) | body ending in `---` + a session-less `_Generated by [Claude Code](…)_` block | ⛔ the block was **STRIPPED** — read back, the body ends at the prose |
| raw REST | `POST /pulls` (PR #17386) | body carrying **no** footer at all | the platform **APPENDED** one — read back: exactly **1** |

⇒ ⭐ On the same afternoon, one channel **deleted** a footer the author sent and another **added** one the author did not. That is the row's thesis in its sharpest available form: ⛔ there is no law here, only cells.

Combined with the readings already on this card and the one at `5615837218`, the grid now has, measured:

- MCP wrapper — **deletes** a block (this card's original observation, and #17384 today)
- MCP `create_pull_request` — **appends** its own, leaving two when the author sent one (`5615837218`)
- MCP re-send with a footer-carrying body — two footers survive (this card, n=1)
- raw REST `PATCH /pulls` — **appends unconditionally**; measured two-way today on PR #17146 (once with the canonical rule+footer block, once with the rule line removed) — **both stored two**
- raw REST `POST /pulls` — **appends** a session-URL footer to a body carrying none (#17386 today)

⭐ **The operational consequence, which is what the file is for**: on the `PATCH /pulls` channel, *exactly one footer* is only reachable by sending **none**. PR #17146's round hit that as a hard conflict between the dispatch's "exactly one" and its "session-URL form", measured it rather than guessing, and resolved it by putting the session id in body **prose** — which is what AGENTS.md prescribes for this mutation class anyway.

⛔ No line-count claim is made here. Whether these cells earn sentences, and how they fit the +39, is this card's ruling to make — ⛔ not evidence's.
